items.description: Disposal of storm debris from shed and felled tree (roof timber, glass pane, green waste, root ball under 1 m3)
items.rationale: Combined position, but every element is material arising under 5.2.1(a)/(b) (shed remains, felled-tree green waste, single root mass not exceeding 1 m3), so 7.1.10 does not bar it. Priced from the Case 8 component levels (about 55 + 32 + 55 + 40).

items.description: Disposal of ground material from churned-up area (excavated soil, sieved topsoil, paving grit)
items.rationale: Ground material is not material arising (5.2.1(d)) and not insured property (4.3(d)). No reinstatement-related ground works and no making good, so this is standalone clearance excluded under 5.2.2; Case 8 gave t = 0 for the same items.
